The paper studies nested counterfactual identification from arbitrary observational and experimental distributions, proves unnesting, and gives a complete identification algorithm for its Layer-1/2 input setting.
The paper establishes the need for observational positivity in gID and provides a sound-and-complete positivity-aware algorithm reducing gID to classical identification subproblems.
